properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: evp_bytestokey (the single-round MD5 OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey KDF as an npm package) is resolved in package-lock.json as a transitive dependency of the browserify crypto stack inside web3. No application code imports it (zero matches in src/**), but it ships with the build, and its MD5-based derivation is retroactively weak for anything long-lived.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: bcrypt-pbkdf@^1.0.0 is resolved in package-lock.json as a transitive dependency (sshpk/http-signature stack under web3). Password-based KDF available to the build; no direct application use found in src/**.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: node-forge@0.10.0 ships RSA keygen/encrypt/decrypt (and X.509 handling) with the build. Quantum-unsafe key transport would be harvestable if used; the web3/truffle toolchain pulls it in, application code does not call it directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: create-ecdh (browserify ECDH shim) is resolved in package-lock.json via the crypto-browserify chain inside web3's dependency tree. Classical ECDH ships with the build; no application call site found in src/**, so it is availability, not a live key agreement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Ed25519 signing is available through tweetnacl@1.0.3 resolved in package-lock.json (transitive dep of the web3/sshpk stack). No application import found — the capability ships with the build, which is what the inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X25519 key agreement available through tweetnacl@1.0.3 (scalarMult) in package-lock.json, transitive dep. No application call site; capability present in the shipped dependency tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js and scrypt-async are resolved in package-lock.json as transitive dependencies (web3/ethereum stack). Memory-hard KDF ships with the build; no application call site found in src/**.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory (confirmed twice, enriched): the AES surface in the resolved tree is broader than crypto-js — node-forge and crypto-js carry AES, and aes-js@3.0.0 (dev, required at package-lock.json:1792 by @ethersproject/json-wallets@5.4.0 alongside scrypt-js) is the ethers keystore-path AES provider (AES-128-CTR + scrypt/PBKDF2 for V3 wallet files). No application code imports any of them; presence is the inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl's secretbox AE (XSalsa20-Poly1305) ships with the build via tweetnacl@1.0.3. Symmetric, so not Shor-vulnerable; recorded because the build carries the primitive. No application call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider inventory: tweetnacl@1.0.3 (NaCl: Ed25519, X25519, XSalsa20-Poly1305) ships with the build as a transitive dependency of the web3/sshpk stack. No import found in application code — availability is the inventory fact, and any future call site inherits these primitives.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider inventory: crypto-js@3.3.0 ships AES, DES, SHA/MD5 hashes, HMAC, PBKDF2, EVP_BytesToKey-style KDFs. Transitive dependency of web3; no application import found — the primitives ship with the build regardless.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider inventory: node-forge@0.10.0 ships RSA, X.509 certificate/CSR handling, TLS and symmetric primitives. Transitive dependency (selfsigned/web3 toolchain); no application call site in src/** — the algorithms ship with the build either way.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: selfsigned@1.10.11 generates self-signed X.509 certificates (via node-forge RSA) for local dev HTTPS. Resolved transitively in the web3/truffle dev stack; no application use found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X.509 parsing/creation machinery ships with the build via node-forge@0.10.0 (transitive dep). No application use found; availability recorded.
